title: Confirmation Dialog
prompt: Build a 'Delete file?' confirmation dialog: a <dialog id="confirm-delete"> named via aria-labelledby pointing at its own heading; a form method="dialog" inside it with a destructive button and a safe Cancel button carrying autofocus; a <style> block styling dialog::backdrop. Full document skeleton required.

tests.name: dialog element with id
tests.hint: The dialog element is the component — no divs, no role fakes.

tests.name: named by its heading
tests.hint: Give the dialog's <h2> an id and reference it from the dialog's aria-labelledby.

tests.name: method=dialog form with two buttons
tests.hint: method="dialog" closes the dialog on submit and exposes returnValue — the platform's own wiring.

tests.name: autofocus on the safe action
tests.hint: Focus lands where autofocus says — put it on Cancel so Enter can't fire the deletion.

tests.name: backdrop is styled
tests.hint: ::backdrop is the pseudo-element behind a modal dialog — dim it so the page reads as blocked.
